description: All color literals in the shipped editable program files, converted to hexadecimal and grouped by purpose. Hex #RRGGBBAA means alpha transparency; #RRGGBB means opaque.
limits: Lists colors explicitly declared in CSS, JS, HTML, JSON, SVG and webmanifest source; does not extract pixels from PNG/JPG/WebP, video or audio files.
Runtime colors chosen by users, algorithmically generated gradients, and theme overrides not present as source literals cannot be enumerated ahead of time.
A source color may appear in more than one category when it serves multiple functions.
File/line examples are representative; the files list records every distinct source file containing the color in that category.
